newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt up as NatWest rates "add".
newsitem.headline: Reckitt up as NatWest rates "add".

text.p: Shares in Reckitt & Colman Plc rose on Thursday as NatWest Securities renewed coverage with an "add" rating, pointing out that it was trading at a discount to other leading European consumer goods stocks, sources said.
The stock was up 10p at 770-1/2 by 0932 GMT after earlier rising as high as 775p, its highest since last October.
Analysts at the brokerage could not immediately be reached for comment.

Reckitt shares were boosted earlier this month as Unilever posted better-than-expected results and sparked bid talk around other consumer goods firms by announcing plans to sell its speciality chemical operations.
